description:
A marketing script has malfunctioned and flooded the mail queue with spam, blocking legitimate support emails. Your task is to clean up the Postfix mail queue using the Webmin/Virtualmin interface.

Goal: Delete ALL emails from 'marketing@acmecorp.test' but strictly PRESERVE all emails from 'support@acmecorp.test'.

Starting State: The Postfix queue is currently paused (messages are held) and contains a mix of spam and legitimate emails.

Instructions:
1. Navigate to the Postfix Mail Server module in Webmin (Servers -> Postfix Mail Server).
2. Open the Mail Queue.
3. Identify and delete the 15 spam messages from 'marketing@acmecorp.test'.
4. Ensure the 5 legitimate messages from 'support@acmecorp.test' remain in the queue.

Warning: Deleting legitimate support emails will result in task failure.
